clock-shift-rate.label: Rule of thumb for how fast the body clock re-aligns after a time-zone change
clock-shift-rate.value: about 0.5 day per time zone flying west (2 h per day), 1 day per time zone flying east (1 h per day)

travel-illness-rugby.label: Illness incidence in elite rugby players before, during and after a trip of more than 5 h time difference
travel-illness-rugby.value: 15.4 per 1000 player-days at home before, 32.6 abroad, 10.6 back home

ventilation-cycling-70.label: Average minute ventilation of elite cyclists riding at about 70% VO₂max
